definitions.explanation: A basic sumo movement in which the wrestler raises one leg high to the side and stamps it down, then the other. It is done in training and in the ring, traditionally to drive away evil spirits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土俵|どひょう}→土俵：12010_dohyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{四股|しこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んだ→踏む：01197_fumu⟧。
examples.english: The wrestler stamped his legs in the ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{四股|しこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百回|ひゃっかい}⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Doing a hundred leg-stomps every morning is a basic part of a young wrestler's training.

notes:
The verb is always ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: {四股|しこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧. Written {四股|しこ} by convention; the kanji ("four thighs") are a phonetic spelling.
